# Legacy API gateway shutting down on May 1

_Category: Announcements · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**Sandra** (4/29/2025):

Reminder: we have been working on an upgrade to Apigee (our API management platform). As previously communicated, [the DNS names for our endpoints are changing](https://discourse.onebc.ca/t/important-domain-name-change-affecting-all-endpoints/406) as part of this work.

On **May 1**, we will be shutting down the old sandbox API gateway.

The base URL for the new sandbox environment is **https://sandbox.api.connect.gov.bc.ca**.
